description_en: Creates a member of the cloud account type in a resource directory
description_zh: 创建资源目录云账号类型的成员
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager create-cloud-account --display-name admin-0000 --email someone@example.com --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudAccount

parameters.help_en:
The member name.

The name must be 2 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

The member name must be unique within the resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
成员名称。

长度为2~50个字符或汉字，可包含汉字、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、英文句点（.）和短划线（-）。

成员名称在资源目录内必须唯一
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder
parameters.name: parent_folder_id

parameters.help_en: The email address used to log on to the cloud account
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: The ID of the settlement account. If this parameter is left empty, the current account is used for settlement
parameters.help_zh: 结算账号ID。取值为空表示采用当前账号结算
parameters.name: payer_account_id

JoinMethod.description_en:
The method used by the member to join the resource directory. Valid values:

invited: The member is invited to join.
created: The member is created in the resource directory
JoinMethod.description_zh:
成员加入方式。

invited：邀请。
created：创建

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the member was last modified. The time is displayed in UTC, as specified by RFC 3339, with Z indicating UTC
ModifyTime.description_zh: 成员修改时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC

Status.description_en:
The status of the member. Valid values:

CreateSuccess: The member is created.
CreateVerifying: The creation is being confirmed.
CreateFailed: The member failed to be created.
CreateExpired: The creation has expired.
CreateCancelled: The creation is canceled.
PromoteVerifying: The upgrade is being confirmed.
PromoteFailed: The member failed to be upgraded.
PromoteExpired: The upgrade has expired.
PromoteCancelled: The upgrade is canceled.
PromoteSuccess: The member is upgraded.
InviteSuccess: The member is invited.
Removed: The member is removed
Status.description_zh:
成员加入状态。

CreateSuccess：创建成功。
CreateVerifying：创建确认中。
CreateFailed：创建失败。
CreateExpired：创建过期。
CreateCancelled：创建取消。
PromoteVerifying：升级确认中。
PromoteFailed：升级失败。
PromoteExpired：升级过期。
PromoteCancelled：升级取消。
PromoteSuccess：升级成功。
InviteSuccess：邀请成功。
Removed：已移出

Type.description_en: The member type. The value CloudAccount indicates a cloud account
Type.description_zh: 成员类型。取值为CloudAccount表示云账号
